name: Jesus Rojas
office: City of Monrovia, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jesus Rojas is an El Monte police officer who had 18 years of law enforcement experience as of 2024.

sentences.text: Jesus Rojas is an El Monte police officer who had 18 years of law enforcement experience as of 2024.

items.text: His campaign website says he supports establishing a stand-alone senior center and term limits for City Council members. His campaign website also lists grants, public safety, parks, youth programs and a dedicated dog park among his priorities. In his 2024 campaign, he said he wanted to address the Monrovia Police Department's staffing shortage and add license plate readers downtown. He also supported more affordable housing, suggesting the city explore its properties and use surveys, and proposed bringing in a civilian team to serve the unhoused population.
